user.title: Set Up Phantom Chess Board
user.description:
Discovered boards: {discovered}

Select a board address or enter the MAC address manually.

data_description.ble_address: The board's Bluetooth MAC address (6 hex pairs separated by colons or dashes, e.g. C8:C9:A3:F2:7C:0A). Visible on the board's serial sticker, the official Phantom app's settings screen, or via any nearby BLE scanner.

lichess_token.title: Lichess Board API Token
lichess_token.description:
Enter your Lichess Board API token for **{device}**.

Create one at https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token — enable **Board API** scope.

data_description.lichess_token: A personal-access token generated on Lichess with the Board API scope enabled. Used only for streaming your active board games and posting moves on your behalf — never read.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Phantom Chess
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Lichess token for **{device}** is no longer accepted (probably expired or revoked). Enter a new Board API token to resume online play.

Create one at https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token with the **Board API** scope.

data_description.lichess_token: A fresh Lichess personal-access token with the Board API scope. Existing token was rejected by the API and needs replacement.

user_manual.title: Manual Board Setup
user_manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Phantom Chess Board manually (e.g. C8:C9:A3:F2:7C:0A). Use colons or dashes.

data_description.ble_address: 6 hex pairs separated by colons or dashes, e.g. C8:C9:A3:F2:7C:0A. Found on the board's serial sticker or any BLE scanner app.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Phantom Chess
reconfigure.description:
Update the configuration for **{device}** (currently linked to Lichess account: `{current_user}`).

Leave the Lichess token field blank to keep the existing token. The BLE address can't be changed here — that would mean a different physical board; remove this entry and add a new one if you've swapped boards.

data_description.ble_address: The BLE address of the board this entry is configured for. Changing it isn't supported — submit a different address and the flow will abort.
data_description.lichess_token: Optional. Paste a fresh Lichess token here to rotate it preemptively (e.g. before expiry). Leave blank if you only want to confirm the existing config.

error.invalid_lichess_token: Invalid Lichess token — check that the token has Board API scope and try again.
error.invalid_ble_address: That doesn't look like a Bluetooth MAC address. Expected 6 hex pairs separated by colons or dashes, e.g. C8:C9:A3:F2:7C:0A.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see Home Assistant logs.

abort.no_devices_found: No Phantom Chess Boards were discovered. Make sure the board is powered on and in Bluetooth range.
abort.reconfigure_entry_not_found: Couldn't find the integration entry to reconfigure. Try again from Settings → Devices & Services.
abort.ble_address_mismatch: The BLE address you submitted differs from this entry's board. To set up a different board, delete this integration and add a new one with the new address.

missing_frontend_deps.title: Phantom Chess dashboard is missing HACS plugins
missing_frontend_deps.description:
The auto-provisioned Chess dashboard at /phantom-chess uses these HACS frontend plugins for its visual polish: **{missing}**.

The dashboard still loads, but tiles will render with broken styling and template substitutions won't run. Install the missing plugins via HACS → Frontend, then reload the Phantom Chess integration (or restart Home Assistant) to clear this notice.

If you've intentionally turned off the auto-provisioned dashboard via the integration's options (Configure → Auto-provision dashboard), you can dismiss this issue — it won't reappear until you re-enable the dashboard.

init.title: Phantom Chess Board options
init.description: Fine-tune integration behavior. Leave fields blank for defaults.

data_description.tts_service: Optional. Pick a text-to-speech entity to speak move announcements and coaching aloud. Leave blank to only fire the `phantom_chess_announce` event for your own automation.
data_description.tts_media_player_entity_id: The speaker to play announcements on (HomePod, Alexa, Sonos, a Voice assistant, any media player). Required if a text-to-speech engine is set.
data_description.tts_language: Optional. Force a language for the chosen engine. For Home Assistant Cloud use a locale like en-GB. Leave blank for the engine default.
data_description.tts_voice: Optional. Force a specific voice. For Home Assistant Cloud use a short neural voice name like RyanNeural. Leave blank for the engine default.
data_description.debug_dump: Off by default. Only enable when troubleshooting an issue.
data_description.auto_provision_dashboard: On by default. When enabled the integration creates and maintains the /phantom-chess dashboard automatically. Disable if you prefer to author your own dashboard — the existing /phantom-chess dashboard will be removed on the next reload.

no_board_configured.message: No Phantom Chess Board configured. Add one via Settings → Devices & Services before calling phantom_chess.* services.

unknown_entry_id.message: entry_id {entry_id} does not match any configured Phantom Chess Board (known: {known})

ambiguous_target_entry.message: {count} Phantom Chess Boards configured — service call must include an entry_id field to target one specifically. Known entry_ids: {known}

start_game.name: Start Game
start_game.description: Start a new chess game against the Lichess AI.

send_move.name: Send Move
send_move.description: Manually inject a move in UCI notation.

start_local_game.name: Start Local Game
start_local_game.description: Start a game against the built-in AI — no Lichess account required.

stop_local_game.name: Stop Local Game
stop_local_game.description: End the local AI game and return the board to idle mode.

resign.name: Resign
resign.description: Resign the current game on Lichess.

back_to_modes.name: Back to Modes
back_to_modes.description: Return to the mode picker and re-home the board.

start_two_player_game.name: Start Two-Player Recording
start_two_player_game.description: Start a two-human recording game on the physical board.

resync_detection.name: Re-sync Board Detection
resync_detection.description: Recovery for a board stuck in Snapping Pieces / matrix mismatch.

resync_two_player.name: Resync Two-Player Board
resync_two_player.description: Recovery action for a two-player recording that has gone out of sync.

start_lichess_configured.name: Start Lichess Game (Configured)
start_lichess_configured.description: Start a Lichess game using the integration's currently-set entities.

play_selected_sculpture.name: Play Selected Sculpture
play_selected_sculpture.description: Play the historic game currently selected in the sculpture-game selector.

start_ai_vs_ai_game.name: Start AI vs AI Game
start_ai_vs_ai_game.description: Run a Stockfish-vs-Stockfish game on the physical board.

takeback.name: Request Takeback
takeback.description: Undo the last N plies on the physical board and in integration state.

debug_ble_write.name: Debug BLE Write
debug_ble_write.description: Diagnostic — write an arbitrary payload to a BLE characteristic.

diagnose_game_start.name: Diagnose Game Start
diagnose_game_start.description: Diagnostic for the firmware GAME_START length rejection.

phantom_start_game.name: Phantom Start Game
phantom_start_game.description: Start a chess game using the activation sequence from the official Phantom app.

phantom_apply_ai_move.name: Phantom Apply AI Move
phantom_apply_ai_move.description: Apply an engine move to the board after a human move has been detected.

reconcile_lichess_state.name: Reconcile Lichess State
reconcile_lichess_state.description: Query Lichess for the current game state and sync local sensors.

resume_from_phone.name: Resume from Phone
resume_from_phone.description: Push the integration's current board state to the physical board.

move_piece.name: Move Piece
move_piece.description: Low-level move primitive — instructs firmware to move a piece via the magnet.

start_sculpture.name: Start Sculpture Mode
start_sculpture.description: Switch the firmware to sculpture mode.

reset_position.name: Reset Position
reset_position.description: Drive the physical board and internal state back to the starting position.

play_sound.name: Play Firmware Sound
play_sound.description: Trigger a check or checkmate sound on the board's onboard speaker.

request_hint.name: Request Hint
request_hint.description: Force-refresh the cloud-eval / Stockfish evaluation for the current position.

dismiss_review.name: Dismiss Post-Game Review
dismiss_review.description: Clear the post-game review state so the dashboard returns to the mode-picker.

execute_move.name: Execute Move
execute_move.description: Execute a UCI move on behalf of the user, driving the magnet to move the piece.
